title: kissed Russian borsch stew
description: a pungent, creamy, and comforting Russian stew ideal for a sick day, featuring mustard powder and a long slow-cooking process, suitable for raw food enthusiasts

ingredients.name: carrots
ingredients.notes: use 4 medium carrots, peeled and grated

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.notes: use 2 medium potatoes, peeled and diced

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.notes: use raw or pasteurized sour cream

instructions: combine beets, onions, carrots, and potatoes in a large slow cooker
add beef broth, water, red wine vinegar, and mustard powder to the slow cooker
cover the slow cooker and cook on low for 8 hours
after 8 hours, stir in sour cream until well combined
taste and adjust seasoning as needed
serve the borsch hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill or chives if desired
reheat the borsch in small portions as needed
store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days
freeze the borsch for up to 2 months
thaw frozen borsch overnight in the refrigerator before reheating
